The '''Taris Affair''' was an investigation undertaken during the last stages of the [[Taris Siege|battle]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] in which [[Tol Cressa]] had a [[Raana Tey|special investigator]] investigate how the [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|ecumenopolis]] gained such a quick entry into the Republic.<ref name="investigation">[[Knights of the Old Republic 23|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 23]]</ref><ref name="Invasion">"[[The Taris Holofeed: Invasion Edition]]"&mdash;[[Knights of the Old Republic 18|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 18]]</ref>
